prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Krypton (Kr) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a hillside wind farm, white turbine towers, a service ladder and tall grass moving in the wind
Time of day: golden hour — warm low sun, long shadows.
Hair: her hair let down loose over her shoulders — same colour and length as the attached image.
Light direction: side light — the light falls from one side, the far side of her face in soft shadow.
Outfit: a club outfit — a body-hugging bodycon dress with geometric cut-outs at the waist and a low back — in denim blues and indigo, with white or cream as the only second colour; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; right now — a strong gust of wind catches her clothes — the hem and every loose piece of fabric lift and flutter, pressing tight against her body line on the windward side, her hair blown to one side, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: walking.
COMPOSITION: an environmental long shot, her complete figure and enough of the place around her; back to the camera; camera at her eye level; she is placed in the right third of the frame, open space of the place to her left.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left arm hangs relaxed at her side.
PROP: with her own right hand she carries a slim sealed glass tube glowing a faint smoky white-violet with one thin orange line low at her side; it is all she holds.
LEGS: mid-stride, one heel lifting.
GAZE: she looks toward the far distance.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — krypton: a colourless, odourless noble gas, about one part in a million of the air we breathe, found in 1898 in the last residue of evaporating liquid air and named from Greek kryptos, the hidden one; in a discharge tube it glows a smoky white-violet, and from 1960 to 1983 a single orange-red line of its light defined the length of the metre; it flares in photographic flash lamps and rests sealed between the panes of triple-glazed windows — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: slender-limbed yet full-busted with rounded hips and a narrow waist — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
